summary: Lake County tower on the Flathead Reservation near St. Ignatius: 1936 steel tower, staffed 1959, cabin vandalized 1963, tower gone by 1969.

facts.design: 18-foot steel tower with a frame cabin
facts.status_note: Cabin destroyed by vandals in 1963 and tower gone by 1969 per firelookout.com; the Forest Lookouts index says removed; firelookout.org lists Tower Gone.

events.note: Record starts in 1936 with an 18-foot steel tower and frame cabin. Build year is taken from the record's first date.
July 1959 Char-Koosta item, quoted by Forest Lookouts, says Joe Gradipe was again holding the lookout position in the Arlee District.
Tower gone by 1969. Forest Lookouts lists the site as removed without a date.

evidence.supports: Lake County, about 11 miles south of St. Ignatius
1936 18-foot steel tower and frame cabin; cabin destroyed by vandals 1963; tower gone 1969
evidence.quote: 1936: 18' steel tower, frame cabin. Cabin destroyed by vandals 1963. Tower gone 1969.

evidence.supports: Lake County and Flathead Indian Agency, 16N-20W-6

evidence.quote: In the Arlee District Joe Gradipe is again holding down the lookout position on Saddle Mountain.

evidence.supports: Char-Koosta named as the source of the item
Forest Lookouts marks the site Removed

notes_for_editor: Two detailed listings agree on the Lake County site and its gone status; no independent confirmation found. The 1959 staffing item is quoted secondhand through Forest Lookouts from Char-Koosta. The 18-foot figure is read as tower height and converted to height_m 5.5; the source does not say whether it is height or a dimension. Search results returned other Saddle Mountains (Powell County, standing; Ravalli County, gone), which were not used. Access left unknown.
